# Conseil & Ned Land

- [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) — Comrade of — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) — fellow passenger on the Nautilus · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P59](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), +12 more</sub>
- [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) — Friend of — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) — close companions · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), +2 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> As the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) travels toward the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), the crew remains vigilant and eager to hunt the mysterious sea monster. Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) engages the skeptical harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) in a debate, using scientific principles of deep-sea pressure to argue that such a powerful creature could indeed exist and cause the damage reported by ships like the [Scotia](../codex/tech.md#scotia).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV NED LAND

> The crew of the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) spends months fruitlessly searching the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) for the mysterious monster, leading to growing frustration and a near-mutiny. [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) eventually promises to abandon the search and return to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) if the creature is not found within three days. Just as the deadline expires on the final night, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spots the target from the deck.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE

> After being thrown overboard from the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), the narrator is rescued by [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and eventually finds [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) clinging to the back of a mysterious, metallic submarine vessel. The three men realize the 'monster' they were hunting is actually a man-made craft. As the vessel begins to submerge, they are discovered by masked men and pulled inside.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE

> After being abducted and locked in a dark, iron-walled cabin, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are visited by two mysterious men whose language they cannot identify. Despite their attempts to communicate in multiple languages, the strangers remain silent and eventually leave. The captives are later provided with a meal, which they eat before falling into a deep sleep.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI

> After waking from a long sleep in their cell, the prisoners realize the submarine has surfaced to ventilate. As time passes without food, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) grows increasingly agitated and eventually attacks the steward when he finally arrives. The scene ends abruptly when the steward speaks to them in French, demanding they listen.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals his identity to Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), explaining that they are now his prisoners on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Despite their lack of freedom, he offers them a tour of the vessel and shares a meal consisting entirely of marine-sourced food. [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) expresses his deep disdain for terrestrial society and his profound love for the independence found beneath the sea.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) gives Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) a detailed tour of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), explaining how electricity derived from sea water powers the vessel's systems, navigation, and machinery. They inspect the ship's layout, including the small boat, kitchen, and engine room, before [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to the saloon to discuss the mechanics of depth control.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) takes the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to the surface to fix their position before setting a course through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). Later, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) shows [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) the wonders of the sea through the saloon's viewing panels, where they observe various marine life. The chapter concludes with [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) reflecting on the mysterious life of the Captain while the vessel continues its journey.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER

> After several days of isolation, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) invites Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) to a hunting expedition at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). Before departing, the Captain explains the advanced technology they will use, including [Rouquayrol](../codex/tech.md#rouquayrol) diving apparatus and electric air-guns, to survive and hunt in the submarine environment. The group then prepares to don their specialized gear for the excursion.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION

> Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) leads Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on an underwater excursion, equipping them with specialized diving gear and air-powered guns. After exiting the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a water-tight chamber, the group walks across the sea floor, observing the vibrant marine life and vegetation. The excursion concludes as they reach the forest of the Island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) observes the daily routines and scientific observations conducted by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) and his crew aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) as they traverse the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). During their journey, they pass landmarks like Hawaii and the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas), collecting specimens and studying the ocean's depths. The chapter concludes with a somber discovery when the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) encounters the wreckage of a sunken ship, the Florida, containing the preserved bodies of its crew.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), eventually arriving at [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), the site of the [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) shipwreck. The narrator recounts the history of the search for the lost vessels, after which Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals he has discovered the final resting place of the survivors' makeshift boat and possesses the original naval instructions from the expedition.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO

> After the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) runs aground on a reef near the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains calm and expresses confidence that the upcoming full moon's tide will refloat the vessel. [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) receive permission from the Captain to go ashore to hunt for fresh game. The trio successfully reaches the island, with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) eager to find land-based food.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

> Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) spend two days exploring the island of [Papua](../codex/places.md#papua), hunting for game and gathering tropical fruits to supplement their diet on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). After a successful hunt that includes capturing a bird of paradise and several kangaroos, the trio enjoys a feast on the shore and briefly contemplates not returning to the ship before their conversation is interrupted by a mysterious stone thrown at them.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

> After being chased back to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) by hostile [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans), Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) and his companions wait for the ship to refloat. Despite the surrounding natives, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) remains unconcerned and eventually prepares the vessel to depart the coral reef, inviting [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to witness how he will handle the boarders.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) prepares to depart the coral reef, Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) reveals that the ship's exterior railings are electrified to repel the surrounding [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans). [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) accidentally experiences the shock himself, and the vessel successfully breaks free from the reef to sail away, leaving the terrified attackers behind.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean) while Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) conducts deep-sea temperature experiments and the passengers observe a phosphorescent sea. Tensions rise when Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) spots something on the horizon, leading him to abruptly confine [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) to their cabin. The three men are then drugged via their breakfast, causing them to fall into a deep, forced sleep as the submarine changes its behavior.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA”

> After waking up to find his companions and himself back in their rooms, Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) is summoned by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) to treat a mortally wounded crewman. Following the man's death, the Captain leads [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a submarine excursion to a coral forest, where they hold a solemn funeral service to bury the deceased crew member in an underwater cemetery.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM
